_schema.purpose: R3. Fallback for figures no free API carries. Values here are merged AFTER all API sources and tagged so they are never mistaken for API-sourced data.
_schema.rule: Never add a number you have not read directly from the cited source. An unfilled entry is correct; an invented one is not.

_unfilled_gaps.ARM: ILOSTAT occupation series ends 2017. armstat.am publishes labour force survey results but not as a machine-readable ISCO-08 feed; filling this needs a human to read the published LFS table and enter it here with a citation.
_unfilled_gaps.NZL: Absent from all ILOSTAT occupation dataflows; OECD SDMX carries no ISCO series. Stats NZ publishes ANZSCO-coded data that would need a manual ANZSCO->ISCO crosswalk.
_unfilled_gaps.SAU: Absent from all ILOSTAT occupation dataflows; GASTAT publishes nationally only.
